Risperidone influences microRNA 593, which in turn causes atrophy, a condition that is subsequently linked to the enzyme responsible for Pseudohermaphroditism. This pathway highlights a potential mechanism by which risperidone could contribute to the development of Pseudohermaphroditism, though the exact nature of the interaction between risperidone and microRNA 593 remains unclear. The evidence supports a causal chain that links the drug to the condition through molecular and enzymatic pathways, but further research is needed to confirm the direct role of risperidone in this process.
